searchSummary: Event sweep for 2026-03-23 (Ukrainian and English, date variants '23 березня 2026', '23.03.2026', 'March 23 2026' with Київ/Київщина plus attack, debris, damage and casualty terms). The nationwide overnight roundup for the night of 22-23 March 2026 (obozrevatel, published 2026-03-23 08:05: 251 drones launched, 234 destroyed or suppressed) reports consequences only in Dnipropetrovsk, Odesa and Cherkasy oblasts and names neither Kyiv City nor Kyiv Oblast. The KOVA news archive for 22, 23 and 24 March 2026 carries no post about an attack or its consequences; its 24 March entry describes the following night's massed strike instead. Clarification sweep 2026-03-24..2026-04-06 found no later publication attributing any consequence in Kyiv City or Kyiv Oblast to 23 March 2026. Every high-ranking 'обстріл Києва 23 березня' result was opened and dated: kyivcity.gov.ua is 2022, life.kyiv.ua and glavcom are 2025, and the remainder describe 23 вересня (September) 2026. The alert record for the date is a single 27-minute Kyiv City alert, consistent with a threat that passed without impact. No sourced consequence for this event date, so nothing is submitted.
